hypothesis: For the frozen AREALS model, increasing the offset radius beyond measured distance error yields an interval with small worst-case errors in tube-derived area, topology and tube-constrained path length, before genuine features merge.
cohort: First eight test-split records in lexicographic ID order. No selection on predictions. Keep failures in the report.
precision: float32, inference mode, no autocast, TF32 disabled
grid: Isotropic cube containing the normalised mesh bounding box with at least 0.60 RMS-radius padding on each side. Coarse grid uses every second sample with twice the cell size. Samples are centres of closed voxels.
distance_units: Original preprocessor's area-weighted point-cloud RMS radius; no claim of physical units.
distance_error: Maximum absolute error on the full grid and independent additional probes. A sampled maximum, not a certified uniform bound.
area: A_r=voxel_volume({d<=r})/(2r). Relative error compares learned and exact-distance A_r at the same r. Also save each A_r relative to actual mesh/analytic area to expose estimator bias.
topology: Betti numbers b0,b1,b2 over F2 of the closed-voxel union using GUDHI top-dimensional-cell filtration. Error is max_k |b_k(pred)-b_k(reference)|. This is discrete offset topology, not an unconditional claim about the original mesh.
paths: Six fixed surface landmarks selected by farthest-point sampling, all 15 pairs. At each grid resolution, attach each landmark to the nearest grid centre with exact distance <= min_radius/2; record attachment distance. Keep these endpoint nodes fixed across radii and fields. Euclidean-weighted 26-neighbour shortest paths in the occupied-voxel graph. Compare learned and reference paths at equal r. A missing learned endpoint/path for a finite reference path has infinite error. Report false connections for disconnected reference pairs separately. These approximate tube-constrained paths, not exact surface geodesics.
aggregation: Maximum over all eight held-out meshes (and, for paths, all reference-connected pairs). Never RMS. Controls are reported separately. Failed/missing cases prevent an unconditional aggregate result.
numerical_checks: Analytic sphere tube volume and topology; exact-field identity control; shifted-distance control; direct comparison of 49 and 97 grids. No numerical threshold will be chosen from model outcomes.
success_criterion: Exploratory evidence only: no accuracy cutoff was supplied. Report the entire preselected scale range and all failures; do not claim a universal resolution window.
scope: Frozen native full autoencoder including surfel and symmetry readouts. No retraining, no parameter/threshold tuning, no evidence for pressure fields or normal-derivative accuracy.
